answer_1.quote: We train a set of [mem] vectors so that arbitrary texts can be accurately reconstructed from them. This process not only allows us to analyze the capacity of these vectors, but also demonstrates that any kind of text can be compressed into compact latent representations and later decoded.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are reconstructed text sequences from trainable [mem] vectors, evaluated for accuracy and cross-entropy.

answer_2.quote: Decoding Capacity (in Tokens): ... defined as the longest text sequence length L for which the token-level accuracy exceeds a predefined threshold...
